item.description: Our little boy is now officially a seven-year-old. For his second birthday, the first one I wrote about here, I talked about gratitude. I reflected on his birth and the simultaneous birth of a new family, my rebirth as a mother, and the joy that transformation has brought me. So much has changed since I wrote that article, but the gratitude and awe I feel remain unchanged.
